protocol.models: per-fold StandardScaler + L2 logistic C=1 (direction) / ridge alpha=1 (volatility)

exploration.selection_rule: rank candidates by paired dev C_real - C_shift: (1) cells with positive delta IC, (2) pooled delta IC, (3) median delta IC, (4) cells with positive delta hit, (5) pooled delta hit

A1-A0.rule: claim only if a metric has >=9/16 improving cells and >=9/16 improving cells with paired bootstrap p-value below the Bonferroni threshold
A1-A0.verdict: null: no evidence the A1 arm adds skill (pre-registered majority + Bonferroni rule not met)
